visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a goatee, wearing a blue baseball cap and a black short-sleeved button-down work shirt, stands in a workshop setting. Behind him is a large black pegboard filled with numerous red and black power tools, specifically brandished as Milwaukee. He holds a black smartphone and speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a digital screen capture overlay displaying a chat interface. A prompt in Traditional Chinese is being typed. Below it is an image of the same man wearing a beanie, sitting on a vintage-style black motorcycle outdoors. (3) The man reappears in a circular inset at the bottom center of the frame, overlaid on a dark background with blue glowing circuit board patterns. Above him, a white box with a light blue border lists technical specifications for motorcycle tires in Traditional Chinese text. (4) The man is back in the workshop environment, looking down at his phone and then back at the camera, continuing his explanation with animated hand movements. (5) As he speaks, various background images flash behind him: first, a group of business professionals in a meeting room, followed by a close-up of a book with dense English text. The man remains the central focus, gesturing with his hands to emphasize points. (6) A second screen capture of a chat interface appears, showing a prompt regarding CNC-related English vocabulary. The interface is dark-themed with a microphone icon visible. (7) The man is shown again in the workshop, but a long list of CNC technical terms and their English translations appears on the right side of the screen over a semi-transparent blue background. He points toward the list while talking. (8) He returns to a full-frame shot in the workshop, holding his phone and pointing with his right index finger upwards, looking energetic and confident. (9) The background shifts to a bright outdoor scene of a large white commercial airplane at an airport gate. The man is superimposed in the foreground, continuing his address to the viewer. (10) The video ends with a high-contrast graphic screen featuring the man's face and the title '工人學AI' (Workers Learn AI) in bold, stylized characters over a circuit background.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator throughout; 4 business people (3 male, 1 female) in an overlay image; 1 person boarding a plane in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged East Asian male with a short goatee and mustache. He wears a blue baseball cap backwards and a black short-sleeved utility/work shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Primary background is a professional workshop tool wall with a black pegboard and numerous red Milwaukee power tools. Secondary backgrounds include a digital chat interface, a corporate meeting room photo, a circuit board graphic, and an airport tarmac with an airplane.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high clarity and a moderate-to-fast pace in Traditional Chinese. The tone is informative and encouraging. A subtle electronic background track with a steady pulse is audible. (2) At roughly seven seconds, a sharp digital 'whoosh' sound marks a transition. The speaker continues without pause, his vocal intensity remaining consistent. (3) A clear 'ding' sound effect occurs around twelve seconds, signaling the appearance of digital information. The BGM continues with a light synth texture and soft percussive beats. (4) Another digital UI 'click' or transition sound is heard as the scene shifts to the next segment. The male voice maintains a professional, narrative-driven intonation, focusing on technical terms. (5) Near the end of the video, a final synthesized chime or jingle sounds as the outro graphic appears, while the background electronic music fades out slightly under the last few spoken words.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Statement -> AI Tool Application (Motorcycle Specs) -> AI Tool Application (Business Meeting) -> Broad Benefit Summary.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate manual workers or apprentices on the practical benefits of using AI tools (like ChatGPT) in their daily professional lives. By demonstrating how AI can quickly provide technical motorcycle specifications and professional English vocabulary for business meetings, the creator encourages workers to leverage technology to overcome knowledge gaps and improve career prospects.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While Milwaukee tools are prominently displayed in the background, the primary focus is educational content about AI, not a specific product pitch.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The high production value and technical workshop setting suggest the creator is a professional in the trades, adding authority to his advice for 'blue-collar' workers.
